did.unittitle: Laurance S. Rockefeller papers, Associates, George Taylor

physdesc.extent: 29 letter document boxes, 3 legal document boxes, and 1 standard record storage box.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: Open for research in accordance with the terms of donation from the Laurance S. Rockefeller estate, 2009.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: The Rockefeller Archive Center has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them, and has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Original order, as received. Series are intellectually arranged by file type.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The files of George Taylor are primarily comprised of his work with the Rockefeller family office (Room 5600) Public Relations department including articles, press releases, biographical sketches of Rockefeller family members, interview transcripts and preparations, as well as annoucements of awards, commemorations and memorials.
The collection also includes select Laurance S. Rockefeller family files including trip files, and documentation of the Mary French Rockefeller giving program.
